channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Taurean Prince | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Taurean Prince from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Taurean Prince
item.description:
Doc Rivers, on Prince returning from neck surgery:

“It's cool because, honestly, I didn't think he'd play this year. The fact that he's worked the way he's worked to get back on the floor, it's just all about him and who he is. It really is. It's really a cool thing.”

Doc Rivers on Taurean Prince, Mar 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Taurean Prince, Cole Anthony, Ryan Rollins
item.description:
Bobby Portis says Milwaukee has the best bench in the NBA

“I think we’ve got the best bench in the NBA: Cole Anthony and Ryan Rollins in the backcourt, then TP [Taurean Prince] at the three, and me and Kuz at the four and five.”

Bobby Portis on Taurean Prince, Cole Anthony, Ryan Rollins, Oct 22, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Lonnie Walker on Taurean Prince
item.description:
Walker said after practice Saturday.

“I’ve gotten hit a lot worse than that. I don’t think it was on purpose. I’m real cool with Prince. He was just trying to get his hands up and his arm got caught with a nice little uppercut. It takes a lot more than just one punch to get me down.”

Lonnie Walker on Taurean Prince, Nov 23, 2021. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Cedi Osman on Taurean Prince, Collin Sexton
item.description:
“He made like 14 or 15 points in a row, and then there was good defense on him, but then he found TP (new Cavalier Taurean Prince) in the corner for a 3-point shot that was wide open. That was a beautiful play from Collin. He could have taken that one too but saw TP was open, and that was the right play, so he made the right play. You can see from his first year until now — he’s just getting better every day.”

Cedi Osman on Taurean Prince, Collin Sexton, Jan 21, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Spencer Dinwiddie, Taurean Prince, Steve Nash
item.description:
Durant on Nash's presence:

“I think having Steve there and collaborating with our floor general every day is only gonna yield good results for our scorers like myself and Taurean, Caris and Spencer. Them having that relationship I think is gonna be key for us going forward.”

Kevin Durant on Spencer Dinwiddie, Taurean Prince, Steve Nash, Oct 1, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Taurean Prince
item.description:
Kenny Atkinson on #Nets extending Taurean Prince:

“But sometimes you’ve got to bet on people and bet on humanity and bet on a player and that’s what we did. I’m thrilled.”

Kenny Atkinson on Taurean Prince, Oct 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Taurean Prince
item.description:
Kenny Atkinson on #Nets extending Taurean Prince:

“That’s an early call. On his part too, right? So he’s got to make the commitment to our organization, we’ve got to make a commitment without actually playing a regular season game...”

Kenny Atkinson on Taurean Prince, Oct 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Taurean Prince
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Dragic on Taurean Prince:

“Maybe because his last name is Prince he thinks he’s royalty. I don’t know.”

Goran Dragic on Taurean Prince, Oct 24, 2017. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Taurean Prince
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Budenholzer on starting rookie Taurean Prince:

“At the end of the day its basketball... I just want him to go play basketball.”

Mike Budenholzer on Taurean Prince, Apr 16, 2017. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.
